content: वारः [वृ-घञ्] .²1 That which covers, a cover. .²2 A multitude, large number; as in वारयुवति; ते स्ववारं समास्थाय वर्त्मकर्मणि कोविदाः <ls>Rām. 2. 80. 5</ls>. .²3 A heap, quantity. .²4 A herd, flock; वारी वारैः सस्मरे वारणानाम् <ls>Śi. 18. 56</ls>. .²5 A day of the week; as in बुधवार, शनिवार. .²6 Time, turn; शशकस्य वारः समायातः <ls>Pt. 1</ls>; अप्सरावारपर्यायेण <ls>V. 5</ls>; <ls>R. 19. 18</ls>; often used in <ab>pl.</ab> like the <lang>English</lang> ‘times’; बहुवारान् ‘many times’, कतिवारान् ‘how many times’. .²7 An occasion, opportunity. .²8 A door, gate. .²9 The opposite bank of a river. .²10 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²11 <ab>Ved.</ab> A tail. .{@-रम्@} .²1 A vessel for holding spirituous liquor. .²2 A mass of water (जलसंघ).
